formal_role: The antiderivative recovers accumulation from a specified rate function
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies what flow or marginal quantity is being accumulated
review_warning: If the rate omits important inflows or outflows the recovered quantity is wrong

formal_role: The constant of integration is fixed by a baseline value
systems_modeling_role: Selects one recovered state trajectory from the family of possible antiderivatives
review_warning: Uncertain baselines shift the entire recovered trajectory

formal_role: Accumulating a rate over its variable should recover the intended quantity unit
systems_modeling_role: Prevents invalid flow-to-stock or marginal-to-total conversions
review_warning: Unit mismatch can invalidate the accumulation

formal_role: Numerical antiderivatives depend on the accumulation rule and grid spacing
systems_modeling_role: Supports reproducible recovery from discrete data
review_warning: Coarse irregular or noisy data can distort recovered accumulation

formal_role: Recovery is valid only over the interval where the rate model is valid
systems_modeling_role: Prevents extrapolating accumulated quantities beyond supported conditions
review_warning: Accumulation across unsupported intervals can create false cumulative claims
